name: Model Context Protocol
title: modelcontextprotocol.io
shortDescription: Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open protocol designed to standardize how applications provide context to large language models (LLMs). It functions similarly to a USB-C port, offering a universal connection interface for AI models to interact with various data sources and tools. This protocol is particularly useful for developers looking to build complex AI-driven workflows and agents, integrating seamlessly with servers and clients across different platforms.
cons: Dependent on community contributions for growth
